system.description:
You come from a community shaped by structure, doctrine, or devotion. Whether bound by faith, duty, or shared purpose, your people value discipline and unity above all. Some serve a cause; others uphold a code. From monastic to military brotherhoods, orderborne societies reinforce strength through their ideals.

Dedicated. Record three sayings or values your upbringing instilled in you. Once per rest, when you describe how you’re embodying one of these principles through your current action, you can roll a d20 as your Hope Die.
